title: Section-normalized bridge to the constant-ring semilinear proper/open calculus
statement: For the actual integral coefficient-system operations [def-sf-integral-system-operations], use the lifted positive quotient rings and their adjacent quotient maps [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Define their bridge to the varying-ring strict-system calculus [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting] by an ordinary direct-image isomorphism that is identity on every component section. Derive its inverse-image isomorphism by ordinary adjoint uniqueness, its derived direct-image comparison by adjoint conjugation, and its open-extension comparison by open-adjoint uniqueness. Also retain ordinary proper-image/limit comparison fixed by identity on every projected section. Its ordinary adjoint conjugate fixes quotient/pullback interchange; its derived comparison is pinned on whole flat-term K-flat representatives by the recorded reduction models [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison]. Define integral proper-image realization by right-adjoint conjugation and open reduction by the inverse open-adjunction mate using the actual completed-ring operations [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. Thus all derived comparisons retain section and adjunction normalizations before finite evaluation. Define the localized ordinary integral interpretation of the finite expressions [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain], using the representative-normalized pull and tensor completion comparisons [def-sf-pull-completion-comparison] and [def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison]. Its map to the completed interpretation is the recursive composite of those completion units; its ordinary pullback, tensor, open, direct-image and proper/open maps are the canonical ringed-site maps and their specified adjunction mates, independent of any realization isomorphism.
